description: Agent Labor Verification: submit an overtime claim with the hours record it answers to: the record with its reference, the worker, the first day of the workweek, the weekly and daily thresholds after which overtime runs, and each day of verified hours worked; the claim with its reference, currency, the regular hourly rate, the overtime premium, the total overtime hours claimed and each day claimed with its regular and overtime hours, the rate on each and the line amount. The signed report gives the record and the claim, the overtime claimed against the hours over the threshold recomputed from the record, the rate on each line’s overtime and regular hours against the base rate and the base rate times the premium, each day’s regular and overtime hours against the hours worked that day, and each day claiming overtime against the hours the record shows that day, and counts them, and names a divergent claim: threshold math that does not recompute, a premium rate missing or applied to the wrong hours, regular hours counted again as overtime, and overtime claimed on a day with no regular hours worked; then a line amount that does not recompute and a line outside the workweek, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No days in the record, no threshold, no claim lines, or no base rate beside a line rate leaves those points unverified. Hours compare to the hundredth and rates to the cent, and the overtime due is the larger of the hours over the weekly threshold and the hours over the daily threshold summed by day; the thresholds and premium are read as supplied. This reads overtime on hours already worked. Verdict labor_overtime_divergent, labor_overtime_partial, labor_overtime_unverified or labor_overtime_consistent. POST /api/labor-overtime-check. Reads the labor records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never schedules or assigns work, never pays wages, never hires, disciplines or terminates anyone and gives no legal advice, which stay with the employer, the worker and their advisers, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Labor Verification reads labor records for work already performed: a timesheet, a work-completion log, the licenses a worker held, an overtime claim, billed labor rates, billed labor hours, worker classification evidence and a wage record, each against the shift record, the agreed task list, the dates worked, the hours record, the rate card, the contracted labor scope, the classification claimed or the verified hours and agreed rates it answers to. The family checks hours, work, credentials and pay after the work is done; the Agent Hiring family checks decisions and documents before engagement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-labor-verification-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-labor-verification/.
